description: Compare LRML with binary OR-union edges (the original Hoi et al. graph), positive-part cosine weights (gamma = 1), or positive-part cubed cosine weights (gamma = 3, Iscen's affinity). Cosine variants use W + W.T, so mutual kNN pairs contribute twice a one-way pair's weight; nonpositive cosine edges are removed. The binary variant is an explicit reference. Phase 2 manifests replay each study's tuned parameters without retuning. The separate Cars Phase 1 HPO config uses only Iscen cosine weighting and tunes gamma. All other settings are inherited from the replay recipe. LRML is uncapped (regularizer_max_ratio = null), matching the existing Phase 2 LRML ablations.
name: lrml_edge_weighting
